+title: 'ACPA-19a: Remove Seatbelt — delete the sandbox section, SandboxComposition and the doctor sandbox probes'
+---
+## What
+Spec: TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-acpagent.md ACPA-19 ("No Seatbelt"). Decision D128 (e). This task has no dependency. Do it first.
+
+ORDER RULE: FoundationModelsMultitool (session `foundationmodelsmultitool-2a`) deletes `SeatbeltSandbox`, `CommandSandbox` and `SandboxPreflight` only after this commit is pushed. When you push, send the commit to `foundationmodelsmultitool-2a` and to `testudoapp-75`.
+
+Delete these files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Tools/SandboxComposition.swift`
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Configuration/SandboxConfig.swift` (`SandboxConfiguration`, `extraWritePaths`, `sandboxOptions`)
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Doctor/ToolsProber.swift`
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Doctor/ToolsDoctor.swift`
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/SandboxConfigTests.swift`, `SandboxCompositionTests.swift`, `Doctor/ToolsDoctorTests.swift`, `Support/StubToolsProber.swift`
+
+Change these files:
+- `Configuration/AgentConfiguration.swift`: remove the `sandbox` property, the `sandbox` coding key, its decode and its `knownKeys` entry. A `sandbox:` key then gives the normal unknown-key diagnostic.
+- `Configuration/ConfigurationYAML.swift`: remove `"sandbox"` from the key list (line ~96) and its description (line ~107).
+- `Tools/ToolCatalog.swift` (~435-530): call `withShell` with no sandbox, in place of `SandboxComposition.composeShell`. Remove the doc text that says that the sandbox is the only gate.
+- `Tools/MCPComposition.swift`, `Doctor/ProbeTimeout.swift`, `Doctor/DisabledSectionCheck.swift`, `Configuration/ToolSectionCodec.swift` (~195): remove the uses and the doc text of the sandbox.
+- `Sources/acp-agent/DoctorCommand.swift`: remove the tools doctor from the doctor registry.
+- Tests that use the sandbox: `ModelCacheDirectoryTests.swift`, `ConfigurationLoaderTests.swift`, `BuiltinCommandsTests.swift`, `Doctor/DoctorRegistryTests.swift`, `Integration/TierTwoTests.swift`, `Support/ShellVerbSupport.swift`, `Support/CatalogRegistryFixture.swift`.
+- README and ARCHITECTURE.md: remove the `sandbox:` section and the Seatbelt text.
+
+Keep `PathGuard` (D21). Use `grep -rn "Seatbelt\|SandboxComposition\|SandboxConfiguration\|ToolsProber\|ToolsDoctor\|extraWritePaths" Sources Tests` to find each use.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No source file and no test file in this package names `SeatbeltSandbox`, `CommandSandbox`, `SandboxPreflight`, `SandboxComposition`, `SandboxConfiguration`, `ToolsProber`, `ToolsDoctor` or `extraWritePaths`.
+- [ ] The shell of a session composes with no sandbox, and a shell command runs.
+- [ ] A `config.yaml` with a `sandbox:` key gives the unknown-key diagnostic. There is no special reader for it.
+- [ ] `acp-agent doctor` has no tools sandbox probe.
+- [ ] The commit is sent to `foundationmodelsmultitool-2a` and `testudoapp-75`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ConfigurationLoaderTests.swift`: a test that a `sandbox:` key gives the unknown-key diagnostic.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/Doctor/DoctorRegistryTests.swift`: the registry has no tools doctor.
+- [ ] Shell tests (`Support/ShellVerbSupport.swift` users) pass with no sandbox.
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` pass with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1
\ No newline at end of file
